note: 8/19-8/21. The test for a negative is whether the term can produce an ADMISSION, not its cost per conversion. Several blocked terms converted cheaply -- that is the point: a detox or inpatient seeker who fills in a form is a referred-out on the admission board, not revenue. Competitor and partner terms are the opposite case and are protected rather than blocked.

budgets.reason: EXCEPTION to the standing no-increases rule, taken deliberately before 8/25. Branded converts at $22-32, cheapest in the account, and the keyword that made it look expensive was removed 8/13. Tension to keep visible: decided on the 30-day budget-lost figure of 70.3%; the 7-day figure is 23.7%, so most of that headroom had already closed. A test, not a settled case.

keywordFinalUrls.reason: Each of these keywords names a specific service that has its own well-built page, and the ad they sit under points somewhere generic. A keyword-level final URL overrides the ad's without touching ad copy, so no ad is resubmitted for policy review -- which matters while the addiction-services certificate question is open. Expect this to move quality score directly: iop near me currently carries a QS of 4.

removeAssets.label: Sober Living
removeAssets.reason: Advertises a service OCH does not provide. Their own page states they work with partner homes and refer clients out. On a LegitScript-certified account, advertising a service you do not deliver is a compliance exposure, not just a dead sitelink -- and the destination is flagged DESTINATION_NOT_WORKING on top of that. Detached rather than deleted, so it can be re-linked if OCH says they do provide it.
